verdict.rationale: The axis applies since billing/API platforms commonly offer sandbox/test environments, but the evidence pack never mentions a distinct sandbox or test-mode environment isolated from production data — only 'testing pricing changes against historical usage' (orb-docs-1), which is backtesting, not a sandbox. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/test-mode environment, API keys or docs distinguishing test vs live data, confirmation that test data never touches production.
